plugins.name: designer
plugins.description: A working UI-design practice for Claude: commit to one visual stance, build on semantic tokens, use real content, and check the result against an accessibility and taste floor. Includes an aesthetic-ingredient sampler, eleven reference files, and an optional Essentialist designer persona distilled from the Bauhaus, Dieter Rams, and Jonathan Ive lineage. Reconstructs the workflow method observed in Figma Make; not affiliated with Figma, Inc.
